description:
## Goal

Make JIT/AOT compilation incremental below the whole-root NativeProgram boundary: compile only new or changed semantic native-body products and relink the exact affected root artifact.

## Combined-head truth

fz-kdt.163 currently removes duplicate physical CPS graphs only after whole-root lowering. Its deterministic ownership index, graph comparison, and remap preserve semantic executable identities but are transition work: the combined census preserves 5,763 semantic entries while removing 55 roots, 146 continuations, 201 bodies, and 47,760 native bytes through 206 whole-program passes, 18,569 indexed bodies, 6,796 graph comparisons, and 6,107 body comparisons.

Incrementality must make equivalent semantic body/content the product identity before lowering and compilation. This ticket absorbs the proven equivalence rules, then deletes fz-kdt.163's post-lowering whole-root dedup/index/compare/remap pass instead of caching its output beside the new products.

## Strategy

1. Define stable typed semantic identities for native bodies, wrappers, content, target/configuration, ABI, captures, direct callees, construction words, effects, extern marshals, and relocations; no root-relative dense id, rendered/canonical Ty string, or raw interner order is authority.
2. Publish one immutable native-body product per semantic identity plus exact root link/entry products.
3. Persist compiled generations in the compiler-owned backend cache and retire them with explicit root/configuration ownership.
4. Invalidate only moved body inputs; relink only membership, symbol, or relocation readers.
5. Port fz-kdt.163's positive and negative equivalence corpus proofs to the pre-lowering identity, then delete its sharing pass, ownership index, graph/body comparison, remap, counters, and post-lowering fixtures that no longer prove a distinct property.
6. Delete whole-program body walking and fresh-backend recompilation once every front door uses keyed products.

## Signal and acceptance

- Same compiler/root twice and an unreachable edit: zero body lowering, compilation, sharing pass, and relink work.
- Reached leaf edit: only the exact body and relocation/link dependents compile.
- Equal reproduction preserves generations and canonical handles.
- Semantic executable inventory, callable construction, ABI/layout, effects, extern behavior, symbols, debug behavior, runtime output, and canonical artifacts remain exact.
- Deterministic work/generation counts, not time, are authoritative; full native/library/serial matrix, cross-process determinism, all doors, formatting, check, strict clippy, and docs pass.
title: Reuse native code generation by changed function generation
